_doc: Copy this object as a new entry into metadata/registry.json. Replace every value containing TODO. Run scripts/validate_metadata.py to confirm conformance. See docs/POC_STANDARD.md and docs/INCIDENT_INTAKE.md for the full intake flow.
title: TODO short title (e.g. Protocol Name — primitive)
exploit_primitive: TODO short phrase describing the primitive used
summary: TODO 1-2 sentences: what happened, in plain language.
root_cause: TODO 1-3 sentences: the broken assumption (not the fix).
impact: TODO loss figure or qualitative impact, sourced to references.
attacker_path: TODO numbered or comma-separated steps the attacker actually performed.
invariant_broken: TODO the protocol property that should have held but didn't.
attacker_profit_check: TODO concrete assertion the PoC will use to prove attacker profit.
victim_loss_check: TODO concrete assertion the PoC will use to prove victim impact.
attack_tx: TODO 0x... transaction hash on the relevant chain
patch_reference: TODO URL of the patch / fix commit if any
writeup_reference: TODO URL of canonical writeup / post-mortem
audit_lesson: TODO one short sentence an auditor should remember
notes: TODO any caveats, especially what is NOT reproduced and why.
